title: E1.1 / E1.2 / E1.3 — does the channel result transfer when the corpus geometry stops matching the partition
frozen_before: This file was committed before any entry named under entries existed in the corpus, before any arm ran, and before any E1.x number existed anywhere. Nothing in it was chosen after a result was read.
supersedes_nothing: E1 (0032) and E2 (0036) are closed and are not rerun, altered, or reinterpreted by this protocol.
question: E2 measured that removing Physical loses 39 of 90 localisation events while keeping only Physical reproduces all 59 at the same budgets. Is Physical actually dominant, or did an axis-aligned corpus make an axis-aligned instrument look dominant?

hypotheses.H-PHYS: The five-channel model is effectively one channel plus explanation; only-Physical matches full on geometry the atlas does not partition along.
hypotheses.H-SHAPE: Physical's E2 parity is a property of corpus shape; on curved, discrete or edge geometry the full instrument localises pairs that only-Physical does not.

plan_reason: Every one of these is E2's value, from 0034, unchanged. The point of reusing them is that a difference between E2's numbers and this experiment's can be attributed to corpus shape and to nothing else. Budgets and seeds were not chosen to make any new entry reachable.

corrections.dated: 2026-10-08, after this file was committed and before any entry named in it was authored or any arm ran
corrections.why: An audit of this protocol against the committed code and against 0029/0034/0036 found nine defects. None of them was found by looking at a result of this experiment; the experiment has not been run.
list: C1 The primary metric said 'localises at least one declared region'. The committed code defines localisation as EVERY declared region lying inside a mostly-justified suspicious cell (harness::sweep: localised_regions == declared_regions), which is how E2 counted 59 of 90. Corrected to the code's definition, because a protocol that silently redefines the deciding quantity is not reproducing the experiment it cites.

C2 The arm list was cut from E2's eleven to seven for cost. That made an arm-only anomaly (less evidence localising something the full instrument did not) invisible on four of the five single-channel arms, and the information lost was exactly the kind this experiment might not want to see. E2's eleven arms are restored, so every arm here has an E2 counterpart.

C3 The reproduction gate compared only localisation, detection and cost columns, which are all not-applicable on a control, and described control/symplectic_spring as the control whose trust ledger E2 published when the published 100%-UNKNOWN-to-TRUSTED ledger is aerospace/projectile_clean. The gate now compares the volume columns too, so controls carry weight in it, and the fourth anchor is projectile_clean.

C4 The tightened outside check for predicate regions was vacuous as written: truth::margin measures distance from the envelope box, so a point the predicate carves away is never counted as outside and no tolerance can ever be applied to it. Replaced by an adjacency rule that can fire. And the lattice that defines a predicate region's overlap decides localisation itself, so its sensitivity is now measured and reported rather than assumed away.

C5 'unplaced must be 0' was 0029's pre-registered E12 metric; this protocol had turned it into a discretionary exclusion with no floor. Restored to a hard reading: any unplaced measurement on a Choices entry makes that entry's rows not measurable, named per (entry, seed), and the cause is an infrastructure defect to fix and re-measure separately.
C6 trusted_over_true had no numerator rule and E1.3's safety check had no pass condition. Both are stated now.

C7 Nothing said how a one-pair divergence must be worded, and nothing separated an edge/* divergence caused by the documented remove-a-channel-to-gain-trust route from one caused by geometry. Both are constrained before the fact now.

C8 The new entries' domains, coefficients and region sizes were pinned nowhere, so 'not a cosmetic variant' was unenforceable after authoring. Each region-bearing entry must now match a named existing entry's difficulty within a factor of two, declared in its truth file and checked by the audit.

C9 This protocol attributed to E2 a statement E2 never measured, that an all-non-finite region labels TRUSTED under -physical. That is a code-path reading taken during this session's audit and it is cited as one.

arms_reason: E2's eleven arms, unchanged. full vs only-physical tests whether one channel suffices; full vs no-physical tests whether Physical is load-bearing; the other four removals make 'another channel became load-bearing' a measurement rather than an assertion; the other four single-channel arms make 'less evidence localised something full did not' visible for every channel rather than for one. Fusion necessity is reachable: a pair full localises while all ten subset arms fail on it.

entries.refusal_reason: aporia-ir refuses a non-finite interval edge and an inverted domain, so the two domain/* entries cannot be sampled at all. 0029 pre-registered E13 as 'refusal at the IR gate, not a label': they are in entries.run because a refusal the plan never named is not a refusal the plan can report, and run_corpus records each one with the diagnostic that produced it instead of skipping it. They are never swept, never counted in the primary universe, and never appear as a label.

truth_form.adds: a region may carry a boolean arithmetic 'where' expression that carves its required axis-aligned envelope down to the exact set
truth_form.grammar: parameter names, decimal literals with optional sign and exponent, + - * /, > >= < <= == !=, and, or, not, parentheses; no function calls, no exponent operator, no units, no conditionals; standard precedence with not > and > or and comparisons looser than arithmetic
truth_form.membership: x is in the region if and only if x is in the envelope and the predicate is true at x
truth_form.measure: envelope fraction times the share of a fixed midpoint lattice — 32 samples per axis at lo + (i + 0.5) * width / 32 — that satisfies the predicate; a cell's overlap is sampled on the same lattice over cell intersect envelope, scaled by the intersection's share of the cell, so it keeps meaning 'the fraction of the cell inside the declared region'
truth_form.v1: aporia.truth/1 files are read exactly as before and box semantics are unchanged; a 'where' under /1 is refused rather than reinterpreted as the envelope
truth_form.why: a staircase of axis-aligned boxes would leave the truth axis-aligned, which is the confound this experiment exists to remove, and would make declared_regions a count of how coarsely the author chopped a curve
truth_form.outside_check: A predicate region claims the whole failing set rather than an inner approximation of it, so a point that violates the model while sitting outside the region is a corpus bug. truth::margin measures distance from the envelope box, so it cannot see the carved-away interior and no tolerance can be applied there; instead every violating point outside the region must be adjacent to an in-region point on the grid-41 verification lattice, counted as one step in any axis. A violating point further than one step from the region refuses the entry, and the boundary-layer count is reported per entry.
truth_form.lattice_sensitivity: That same lattice decides localisation for a predicate region, because its overlap_of is measured on it, so a cell straddling a curved boundary could fall on either side of the 0.5 bar by sampling luck. Each outcome therefore records whether its localisation decision changes when the lattice doubles to 64 samples per axis. A pair whose full or only-physical row is flagged is reported as not measurable (lattice-sensitive) and excluded from F and O by name -- never scored as sameness, never scored as a difference.

primary_metric.name: single-channel-sufficiency transfer
primary_metric.universe: the (entry, seed) pairs of the new region-bearing entries only: geometry/diagonal_sum, geometry/curved_product, geometry/narrow_oblique, geometry/curved_arc, discrete/scheme_branch, discrete/mixed_magnitude, discrete/lattice_two, edge/overflow_tail, edge/pole_at_edge — 9 entries x 5 seeds = 45 pairs. Controls and anchors are excluded by definition; anchors decide the reproduction gate instead.
primary_metric.definition: F = pairs where the full arm's localised_at_budget exists within the ladder. In the committed code that means EVERY declared region of the entry lies inside a suspicious cell at least half inside declared regions (harness::sweep: localised_regions == declared_regions) -- the same quantity E2 counted to reach 59 of 90. O = the same for only-physical. Deciding statistic: |F \ O|, read off localised_at_budget per sweep by the same committed comparison code E2 used, from the committed results files.
decision_rule: 1. F empty -> UNRESOLVED: the full instrument localises nothing on the new geometry, so transfer cannot be tested. Reported as a statement about the corpus with per-entry detail; the ladder is not widened to make a region reachable.

2. |F \ O| >= 1 -> H-SHAPE supported: single-channel sufficiency does not transfer. Physical's E2 parity was a property of the axis-aligned corpus on the named pairs. 2a. If on those pairs all five single removals still localise, the loss came from dropping four channels at once, which is fusion rather than one extra channel; if a single removal also fails there, that channel is named instead.
3. |F \ O| = 0 and |O \ F| = 0 and every pair agrees on the budget at which it localised -> H-PHYS supported: Physical dominance persists on curved, discrete and edge geometry.

4. |O \ F| >= 1 -> an arm with less evidence localised something the full instrument did not. Not counted as a win for Physical; reported by name for ledger inspection, in the category E2 used for trust gained by removing the channel that was withholding it.
primary_metric.wording_tiers: Every pair in F \ O is named as an (entry, seed, budget) triple. If all of them lie on one entry, the conclusion is worded as a divergence on that entry, never as 'E2's result is a corpus artifact'; on one entry across several seeds it is worded as that entry across those seeds; the transfer claim needs divergence on at least two entries and at least two seeds. 0029's rule for a small n applies to a favourable result as much as to an unfavourable one: one graph is not a finding.
primary_metric.edge_entries: A divergence on edge/overflow_tail or edge/pole_at_edge is reported in its own class and never folded into the E1.1/E1.2 headline, because those entries are built so that a channel's evidence can be non-finite, and the documented route from removing a channel to gaining TRUSTED volume can produce a difference that is about the labelling rule rather than about geometry.
primary_metric.no_thresholds: The arms are deterministic same-seed runs, so any difference is caused by the mask. No tolerance, no rounding and no 'close enough' converts a difference into sameness.

secondary_metrics: the same tally for each single removal, per family, with full_only, arm_only, both, neither and budget-order counts
detection, findings and the per-channel census on the new entries, which is what separates 'nothing to say here' from 'changed nothing'
under-claim (0029's E11 metric): at the top budget, the fraction of each declared region's measure covered by the union of SUSPICIOUS leaves, per entry and arm
boundary tolerance flips per declared boundary, with not measurable kept distinct from zero

volume deltas, and trusted_over_true: the fraction of the DOMAIN that is both labelled TRUSTED and inside a declared region, in the same units as suspicious_volume, sampled on the predicate lattice for a where region. It is an absolute volume and never a ratio of two volumes, so no arm can produce a 0/0 that would have to be read as either a pass or an absence. E1.3's pass condition, frozen now: on edge/overflow_tail and edge/pole_at_edge every arm must report trusted_over_true = 0. A non-zero value is the documented route being taken -- a cell labelled trustworthy on evidence that could not say anything -- reported by name, per (entry, seed, budget, arm).

unplaced measurements per sweep. 0029 pre-registered this as E12's metric and it stays a hard requirement: unplaced > 0 on a Choices entry makes that entry's rows NOT MEASURABLE, named per (entry, seed), and the cause is an infrastructure defect to fix and re-measure separately. It is not a discretionary exclusion, and no fraction of the universe may quietly vanish this way
label coverage as the resolved fraction, read as continuous-span volumes on discrete axes
per-seed and per-budget breakdown, and per-entry rows named
not_claims: More TRUSTED volume is not better, more detections is not better, and fewer findings is not better. A pair counts only when the declared truth says the region was localised.

refuses: duplicate entries: normalised model source equal to another entry's, or a truth region equal to another's

malformed truth: unreadable schema, an axis the model does not have, a region with no reason, non-finite bounds, a where under aporia.truth/1, a predicate that does not parse, a predicate that is NaN anywhere in its envelope
out-of-domain or off-choice-set region bounds, which Truth::volume_fraction currently clamps silently to the whole axis
unreachable regions: corpus::verify at grid 41, plus every region must contain at least one grid point
vacuous checks: a control that declares regions, a region equal to the whole domain, a model that never violates anywhere, a property or symmetry declaration the campaign cannot exercise
bad discrete mappings: two declared choices with identical truth boxes, or a choice with no declared truth
unit inconsistencies: the frontend's unit diagnostics, and no new entry may silence a unit warning to compile
implementation-derived truth: a new entry's method must be analytic or ir-refusal and its derivation must state a closed form; the measured method is refused for every entry in this protocol

difficulty matching: every region-bearing entry names an existing corpus entry in a matched_to field, and its declared truth volume fraction must lie within a factor of two of that entry's, so difficulty is fixed against the corpus E2 already measured rather than tuned while authoring
nondeterminism: the same plan over the same entries twice must give byte-identical sweeps and outcomes, with only wall_ms and environment allowed to differ

stale artifacts: a results row whose identity does not recompute from its own document, an archive directory not named for the arm that wrote it, a results README row naming a file that is not in the tree
audit_gate.order: the audit and verify --grid 41 must both be green before the pilot, and the pilot must be green before the full run

reproduction_gate: On the four anchors every arm must reproduce E2's committed rows exactly, per (entry, seed, budget): localised_regions, detected_regions, evaluations, instruction_steps, and the suspicious, trusted and unknown volumes. The volumes are in the gate because localisation and detection are not-applicable on a control, and a labelling change would otherwise slip past a gate built only from event counts. Checked as a pre-run step on seeds 1-2, and again over all five seeds on the full run's own rows. A mismatch means the instrument changed, the run is invalid, and the new corpus is not read for anything.
not_touched: Policy::classify, the measured mask, calibration, correlation, fusion, and every labelling rule — including the route E2 documented, where a single-channel arm that computes nothing certifies a whole domain as TRUSTED. E1.3 measures how often that route is taken; it does not close it.
budgets, seeds, arms, strategies, rates, cost basis and every metric definition in this file, after any arm is read
E2's result files and their recorded identities
limitations_this_does_not_remove: the atlas has no notion of a discrete axis: it partitions a Choices axis's value span continuously, so a cell can straddle values no model point occupies. E1.2 measures what that partition does with discrete structure; it does not fix the partition.
every new entry is at most 3-dimensional; a curved region in 4 or more parameters at budget 1280 is a different experiment from one about geometry

the 32-per-axis lattice makes a curved region's volume an estimate while its membership stays exact; the estimate is identical for every arm, so it cannot create or destroy a full-versus-arm difference
the corpus is still authored by one person. These entries test the instrument's geometry handling; they do not make the corpus external.
